payload.description_html: Fig. 31 - Interpretative reconstruction of  the whole skeleton of  Pholidolepis teruzzii sp. n., from the Sinemurian Osteno Lagerstätte, Como Pro-vince, Northwestern Italy. Reconstruction based on the holotype, MSNM V564-V621. (A) Skull skeleton in left lateral view. (B) Skull skeleton in dorsal view. (C) Full body reconstruction in left lateral view. Scale bars 5 mm for A and B, 10 mm for C
